name: Ainsworth Game Technology Limited
summary: Ainsworth Game Technology Limited designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and distributes gaming content and platforms, including electronic gaming machines, and other related equipment and services. The company also offers online real-money and social games. It operates in Australia, the Asia Pacific, North America, Latin America, Europe, and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Newington, Australia. Ainsworth Game Technology Limited is a subsidiary of Novomatic AG.
